# @bun-erp/mail

Server-only, app-agnostic mail transport for the Bun ERP workspace. Install with
`bun erp features:install mail`; the package alone is not wired into the app.

## Public exports

- `@bun-erp/mail` (alias of `/server`, the package is server-only): `createMailer(options)`,
  `createMailRegistry()`, `MailDriverRegistry`, `resolveMail(message, config)`, `htmlToText(html)`,
  `escapeHtml(value)`.
- `@bun-erp/mail/server`: the same surface when the server subpath reads better.
- Types: `Mailer`, `MailMessage`, `MailAddress`, `MailAttachment`, `MailConfig`, `MailLogger`,
  `MailEnqueue`, `MailDriver`, `MailDriverContext`, `ResolvedMail`, `MailPayload`.

## Contract

- `createMailer({ config, logger, enqueue? })` takes plain objects; it never imports app code.
- `send()` resolves defaults (from-address, text fallback) and calls the selected driver.
- `queue()` writes a JSON-safe `mail.send` payload through `enqueue`; without `enqueue` it sends
  inline and returns the driver message id.
- Drivers: `log` (structured line, default), `memory` (in-process capture for tests), `smtp`
  (lazy `nodemailer` import; unavailable on Cloudflare Workers), `http` (Resend over `fetch`; works on
  Workers; needs `MAIL_API_KEY`).

## Read first

- `README.md`: install path, exports, driver behavior, config keys, and test split.
- `src/server/types.ts`: the full public contract.
